definition{
  name: decodeFields, parameters: [fields : (List String)], result: Bytes,
  body: (match fields | List.nil => (MatterReview::refusal "review" "request" "Complete the intake and review fields.") | List.cons operation rest => (if (prim equal operation "raw" : Bool) then (match rest | List.nil => (MatterReview::refusal "raw" "request" "Add intake text.") | List.cons content rawTail => (match rawTail | List.nil => (MatterReview::evaluate "raw" content "" "" "" "client") | List.cons surplus more => (MatterReview::refusal "raw" "request" "Add intake text."))) else (if (prim equal operation "review" : Bool) then (match rest | List.nil => (MatterReview::refusal "review" "request" "Complete the intake and review fields.") | List.cons content afterContent => (match afterContent | List.nil => (MatterReview::refusal "review" "request" "Complete the intake and review fields.") | List.cons quotation afterQuotation => (match afterQuotation | List.nil => (MatterReview::refusal "review" "request" "Complete the intake and review fields.") | List.cons facet afterFacet => (match afterFacet | List.nil => (MatterReview::refusal "review" "request" "Complete the intake and review fields.") | List.cons interpretation afterInterpretation => (match afterInterpretation | List.nil => (MatterReview::refusal "review" "request" "Complete the intake and review fields.") | List.cons audience afterAudience => (match afterAudience | List.nil => (MatterReview::evaluate "review" content quotation facet interpretation audience) | List.cons extra surplus => (MatterReview::refusal "review" "request" "Complete the intake and review fields."))))))) else (MatterReview::refusal "review" "request" "Complete the intake and review fields.")))),
  recursive_argument: fields, axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: dispatch, parameters: [input : Bytes], result: Bytes,
  body: (if (32768 <? (Foundation.Bytes::byteLength input)) then (MatterReview::refusal "review" "limit" "The intake request is too large.") else
    (match (Foundation.Utf8::decode input)
      | Option.none => (MatterReview::refusal "review" "encoding" "Use a UTF-8 intake request.")
      | Option.some text => (match (prim split_exact text "\u001f" (8 : UInt32) : (Option (List String)))
        | Option.none => (MatterReview::refusal "review" "request" "Complete the intake and review fields.")
        | Option.some fields => (decodeFields fields)))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}
